name: guardrails-challenge
description: Effective challenge: hold answers to evidence under pushback, and check agents' commit claims against git.

pushbackCheck.title: pushback-check
pushbackCheck.description: When you challenge an answer, tell the model to re-check the source and hold or change its answer on evidence, not pressure.

commitClaimAudit.title: commit-claim-audit
commitClaimAudit.description: When a subagent's report names a commit, place the real git show --stat next to it.

heartbeatDir.title: Heartbeat folder
heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
